title: Effect of Cervical Collar on the Optic Nerve Sheath Diameter in Minor Head Trauma
brief_summary: This is randomized, controlled and blinded study was performed in minor head trauma patients. Two sonographers measured optic nerve sheath diameters (ONSD) of each subjects' eyes separately for different time points. Then a mean ONSD was calculated for before c-collar placement (T0), 5 and 20 minutes in supine position.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with minor head trauma
* Patients over 18 years and under 65 years
* Those who signed the Informed Consent Form

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who can not be followed for any reason (treatment, refusal, unauthorized leave, referral to the center, etc.)
* Patients who withdraw their consent
